name: MSP-EXP430FR2433 LaunchPad
description: Classic ultra-low-power FRAM LaunchPad: MSP430FR2433 (16 MHz, 15.5 KB FRAM) with eZ-FET debugger and EnergyTrace, 20-pin BoosterPack headers and a supercapacitor footprint.
notes: Two buttons and two LEDs; supports a user-installed supercapacitor instead of a battery. Includes a micro-USB cable.
$9.99 is TI's own price as reported by an aggregator (not confirmed on TI's page); DigiKey and Mouser list about $13-14. Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
